mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.sort, r.status, r.remark, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.deleted FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.sort ASC
